reason: The report controls for collab_index_2023, a 2023 post-treatment variable that remote_share strongly predicts (coefficient 0.68), so it is a mediator or collider. That control creates the negative sign. My re-run without it, using only the 2020 pre-period controls, gives a positive effect of about +0.75 (SE 0.23). Without any controls the effect is about +2.3. The 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported.
